resolvedStack: React Native / Expo SDK 52 + Expo Router + TypeScript + AsyncStorage
name: PocketLedger Expense Tracker
description: PocketLedger Expense Tracker is an offline-first Expo React Native mobile companion for logging daily personal and freelance expenses across budget categories, monitoring monthly spend caps, toggling recurring bills, and persisting all ledger entries locally via AsyncStorage.

metadata.name: PocketLedger Expense Tracker
metadata.description: Offline-first Expo SDK 52 mobile app for expense tracking, category budgets, and local AsyncStorage ledger.

files.description: Expo SDK 52, expo-router, react-native-web, react-native-safe-area-context, @expo/vector-icons, and @react-native-async-storage/async-storage configuration.
Expo configuration with Metro web bundler, expo-router plugin, and scheme.
TypeScript configuration extending expo/tsconfig.base with @/* path alias.
Semantic design tokens for PocketLedger mobile UI.
Expo Router Web HTML document shell.
Expo Router root Stack layout wrapped in SafeAreaProvider with web Live Edit inspector installer.
Expo Router bottom tab navigator layout for index, expenses, budgets, and settings.

Shared TypeScript types: ExpenseCategory ('FOOD' | 'TRANSPORT' | 'UTILITIES' | 'SOFTWARE'), ExpenseEntry { id, title, amount, category, recurring, cleared, loggedAt }, BudgetLimit { category, monthlyLimit }.

Offline-first hook/store using @react-native-async-storage/async-storage (getItem/setItem) with realistic seeded ExpenseEntry[] and BudgetLimit[], exporting BOTH named useExpenseStore and default export, returning an object { expenses, budgets, addExpense, toggleExpenseCleared, updateBudgetLimit, resetDemoData, getMonthlyTotal }.
Reusable React Native card component rendering ExpenseEntry details, category badge, formatted amount, recurring label, and Pressable cleared toggle, exported BOTH named and default.

Overview dashboard screen wrapped in SafeAreaView and ScrollView with monthly spend KPI summary cards, budget utilization progress bars, recent ExpenseCard items, and navigation actions via expo-router.
Expenses ledger screen with category filter chips (ALL, FOOD, TRANSPORT, UTILITIES, SOFTWARE), ExpenseCard list with Pressable toggle, and quick form to add a new expense entry.
Monthly budgets screen showing spend vs limit per category and Pressable controls to adjust budget limits.
Offline ledger settings screen displaying total persisted expenses, recurring count, and a Pressable button to reset demo data.
